purpose: Select a useful teaching example, not estimate generalisation performance
discovery: Reviewed scaffold coverage among the first 4000 exact IC50 activity records in the public API, then fetched the complete candidate assays. No potency values were edited and no potency-based subset was selected.
qualification: Rounded exploratory results, not a frozen evaluation benchmark. The selected serialized CSV is re-evaluated by build_example.py and exact output/version metadata are bundled in verification.json. Assay selection after looking at model performance introduces selection bias. The two largest scaffold series in the selected assay generated known controls only; the recommended nine-member scaffold was chosen for six unmeasured combinations, not high predicted potency.
